source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, reducing the cooldowns of the user's moves by 1s; damaging opposing Pokémon 3 times over 0.2s, and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1s when hit. Boosted attacks used during Rapid Spin hit 3 times over 0.5s, do not reduce the cooldowns of the user's moves, nor decrease the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit. Blastoise’s third auto attack is empowered - dealing 3 instances of damage, slowing enemies hit and reducing Blastoise’s move cooldowns by 1 second each.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 移動速度を下げる、待ち時間を短縮する、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。

source.name: Water Gun
source.originalDescription: Shoots a jet of water in the designated direction after 0.2s, damaging opposing Pokémon hit, shoving them for 0.6s and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 1s when hit. Opposing Pokémon hit before the jet of water reaches halfway are shoved the full distance; those hit beyond halfway are shoved a short distance instead. Attacks with a shot of water, shoving enemies and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Water Gun は 相手を押し出す、移動速度を下げる、フォーム・モード・構えを変化させる。

source.name: Skull Bash
source.originalDescription: Tucks in their head then dashes forward after 0.5s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the path and stunning them for 0.5s when it hits. Fiercely rams an opposing Pokémon and leaves it unable to act.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Skull Bash は 行動不能・スタンを付与する。

source.name: Hydro Typhoon
source.originalDescription: Becomes unstoppable for 2s and gains a shield for 4s; shoots immense jets of water in a large circle around themself after 1.1s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing them for 1.5s when it hits. Has the user spout water to attack while spinning, throwing enemies in a large area. This also grants the user a shield. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield
